analysis.step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture describes a video rendering pipeline using EC2 Spot instances. Users submit rendering jobs via a Web/Mobile client to API Gateway, which triggers a Lambda function to validate the request and place it in an SQS Job Queue (SQS #1). EC2 Spot instances pull jobs from this queue, read/write video assets to S3, and send completion status to a second SQS Status Queue (SQS #2). The Validation Lambda can also read from this status queue to return job status to the user. Rendered videos are delivered to users via CloudFront. To manage the Spot instances, a CloudWatch event triggers a Spot Termination Lambda when an interruption notice is received, allowing the instances to drain jobs gracefully. Additionally, a custom scaling mechanism is orchestrated by Step Functions, which triggers a Scaling Lambda to evaluate CloudWatch metrics and adjust the EC2 Auto Scaling Group capacity accordingly.
